rows.remarksWeb: SZWW General Trading Private Limited (Promoter Group) acquired 5 (five) equity shares of NRB Bearings Limited on December 29, 2023 ands also informed the Company and the same has been disclsoed to the Stock Exchange on January 2, 2024 under Regulation 29(1) of SEBI (SAST), Regulations, 2011.

rows.name: NRB Bearing Limited
rows.revisionRemark: We were informed by Ms. Harshbeena Zaveri that there was no actual pledge made by her. The pledge on 48,365,30 shares was created erroneously due to a clerical oversight by one of the employees of the depository participant. It was rectified immediately upon it coming to the notice of the promoter, however, it was downloaded as a part of routine through the beneficiary position data and was erroneously reflected in the shareholding pattern. Therefore, the disclosure was not reported to the stock exchanges. The clarification of the same has been submitted by the Company to NSE vide letter dated December 3, 2021.    With reference to the email received from NSE dated April 19, 2022, the Company has further rectified the pledged figure in the shareholding pattern.

source: NSE corporate-announcements + NSE PIT + NSE shareholding pattern
